You'll experience responsive acceleration and balanced handling, whether navigating city streets or highway driving. The combination delivers 23 city and 32 highway MPG, offering practical efficiency without compromising on performance.

Inside, the cabin reflects Audi's commitment to quality and comfort. Fine Nappa leather seating surfaces create an upscale environment, while heated front sport seats provide warmth on cooler days. The driver's seat features memory settings to save your preferred position, and the Wireless Phone Charging Pad keeps your device ready throughout your journey. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures passenger comfort, and the power moonroof floods the interior with natural light.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout this vehicle. Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus displays vital information on its 12.3" digital screen, while the navigation system provides turn-by-turn guidance. The Bang & Olufsen Sound System with 3D sound delivers premium audio quality, and SiriusXM 360L connectivity keeps you informed with your favorite stations and content. Traffic Sign Recognition assists with speed limit awareness, and Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance reduces fatigue on longer drives.

Safety features are comprehensive and designed to protect you and your passengers. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection. Audi Side Assist monitors adjacent lanes and warns of approaching vehicles, while Rear Cross Traffic Assist helps when backing out of parking spaces. The Exterior Parking Camera Rear gives you clear visibility, and Electronic Stability Control works continuously to maintain traction and stability.

Additional conveniences enhance everyday driving. Auto-Dimming mirrors reduce glare from following headlights, the Auto-Dimming Interior Mirror with Compass adds practicality, and the Alarm System with Motion Sensor provides security. Audi Advanced Key lets you unlock and start the vehicle without removing your key from your pocket. The 18" 5-Arm-Flag Design wheels and Audi Guard Protection Kit complement the vehicle's purposeful appearance.

This 2023 Audi S3 represents an opportunity to own a premium sedan that balances performance, luxury, and technology. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the refinement and capability this vehicle offers firsthand.

The electronic stability control and traction control work in concert with the four-wheel independent suspension to maintain composure through corners and over varied surfaces. Rain-sensing wipers and auto-dimming features adapt to changing conditions automatically.

The black exterior finish accentuates the vehicle's sleek proportions, while the 19-inch alloy wheels with black accents underscore its contemporary aesthetic. Auto-dimming door mirrors and delay-off headlights enhance both visibility and convenience during twilight hours.

The SiriusXM satellite radio and premium 10-speaker system deliver quality sound for your commute or weekend drives. HomeLink lets you operate your garage door from the vehicle, adding convenience to routine tasks.

The black exterior with alloy wheels and body-color bumpers presents a polished appearance that turns heads while the protective all-weather floor liners and carpet trunk mat help preserve the interior. With 19 city and 26 highway MPG, this sedan balances performance with reasonable fuel consumption.

This 2023 BMW 3 Series 330i xDrive represents a refined balance of performance, comfort, and advanced technology, designed for drivers who demand both capability and sophistication in their daily commute and weekend adventures.

- Connected Package Pro
- Driving Assistance Package
- Premium Package
- Comfort Access Keyless Entry
- Active Blind Spot Detection
- Lane Departure Warning System

- Heated Steering Wheel

- Navigation System
- Heated Front Seats
- Driver Lumbar Support
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Compatibility
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 1 Year Subscription

The 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder engine delivers responsive performance while achieving 24 city and 33 highway MPG, paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive for confident handling in any condition. This gray exterior presents a timeless appearance that complements both professional and casual settings, while the Sport-tuned suspension and speed-sensing steering provide engaging dynamics on the road.

Inside, the cabin reflects BMW's commitment to quality and driver engagement. The sport seats with perforated Sensatec upholstery offer comfort for extended drives, while power adjustment and lumbar support allow you to find your ideal driving position. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add premium touches that enhance the driving experience, and dual-zone automatic climate control ensures passenger comfort year-round.

Technology integration is seamless with the BMW Curved Display featuring a head-up display that keeps essential information in your line of sight. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility connect your smartphone effortlessly, while the navigation system and SiriusXM satellite radio expand your entertainment options. BMW TeleServices and ConnectedDrive Services keep you connected and supported throughout your ownership.

Safety features provide comprehensive protection through active blind spot detection, lane departure warning, and active driving assistant technology. The rear parking camera, electronic stability control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to enhance confidence in all driving situations. Multiple airbags, including knee and overhead protection, combine with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS to deliver peace of mind.

At 34,980 miles, this 330i xDrive remains well-preserved and ready to serve your transportation needs for years to come. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this BMW delivers the precision engineering and refined comfort that the brand is known for.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. The 2022 Toyota Camry SE Nightshade delivers the reliability and capability you expect from Toyota in a refined sedan package. With its distinctive Nightshade Edition styling and well-equipped interior, this vehicle combines practical everyday performance with modern conveniences designed to enhance your driving experience.

- Black Shark-Fin Antenna
- Black Door Handles
- Black Mirror Caps
- Black Rear Badges
- Black Rear Spoiler
- Black Window Molding
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration
- Power Driver Seat
- Rear Dual USB Power Port Charger
- All-Weather Floor Liner Package
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel
- 18-Inch Black-Painted Alloy Wheels

This Camry is Toyota Certified, meaning it has undergone a comprehensive multi-point inspection and meets Toyota's rigorous standards for quality and performance. You benefit from Toyota's certification advantage, which provides added confidence in this vehicle's condition and reliability. The certification process ensures that every critical system has been thoroughly evaluated and meets manufacturer specifications.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine delivers responsive performance while achieving an estimated 28 mpg in the city and 39 mpg on the highway, helping you manage fuel costs without sacrificing driving capability. The eight-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly to optimize power delivery and efficiency across varying driving conditions. All-wheel independent suspension provides a balanced ride that handles both highway driving and everyday commuting with composure.

Inside, you'll find front bucket seats with SofTex fabric trim that resists staining and wears well over time. The split-folding rear seat expands your cargo versatility, adapting to whatever you need to transport. Dual-zone automatic temperature control lets front passengers set their preferred comfort levels independently, while rear passengers enjoy a center armrest for added comfort on longer trips.

Safety features are integral to this vehicle's design. Dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, and a knee airbag provide comprehensive occupant protection. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a low tire pressure warning system work together to support confident handling in various situations. The rearview camera gives you visual guidance when backing up, and Toyota Safety Connect with a one-year trial provides emergency communication support.

The Nightshade Edition distinctive appearance sets this Camry apart with its cohesive dark styling elements, including black-painted alloy wheels, black door handles, black mirror caps, and black window molding. The white exterior contrasts beautifully with these accents, creating a contemporary look that stands out on the road.

This 2022 Camry SE Nightshade represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a well-maintained Toyota sedan with modern features and Toyota-certified assurance. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it fits your driving needs.

Park assist with automatic braking takes stress out of tight spaces, while rear cross-traffic braking provides an extra layer of awareness when backing out of parking spots. Electronic stability control, multiple airbags, and four-wheel independent suspension all contribute to a composed, secure driving experience.

This IS 350 F SPORT offers the combination of luxury appointments, capable engineering, and straightforward reliability that Lexus owners value. Schedule your test drive today to discover how this sedan performs on your roads.

- Hybrid powertrain delivering 43 city and 44 highway MPG

Power-adjustable driver and passenger seats with heating and ventilation ensure you find your perfect driving position.

An exterior parking camera, intelligent clearance sonar with parking support alert, and ABS brakes with brake assist provide added security. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

Don't hesitate to give us a call with any questions or for more information. The BMW M5 is a high-performance variant of the BMW 5 Series marketed under the BMW M sub-brand. It is considered an iconic vehicle in the sports sedan category. The majority of M5s have been produced in the sedan (saloon) body style, but in some countries, the M5 was also available as a wagon (estate) from 1992 to 1995 and from 2006 to 2010. The first M5 model was hand-built in 1985 on the E28 535i chassis with a modified engine from the M1 that made it the fastest production sedan at the time. M5 models have been produced for every generation of the 5 Series since 1985. Introduced in 1998 at the Geneva Motor Show, the E39 generation of the M5 was the first M5 to use a V8 engine, resulting in an increase in power output to 294 kW (400 PS). It is also the first M5 to use aluminum front suspension components and a multi-link rear suspension. Production began in October 1998. This 2019 Lexus ES 350 represents a refined midsize sedan that delivers composed driving dynamics and a well-appointed interior designed for comfort and convenience.

- Blind Spot Monitor with Park Assist and Lane Change Assist
- 18-inch Split 10-Spoke High Gloss Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- 12.3-inch Navigation Display
- Premium Package with Heated and Ventilated Seats
- Power Tilt/Telescoping Steering Wheel with Memory
- Heated Leather and Wood Steering Wheel
- Rain Sensing Wipers

- Rear Cross Traffic Auto Brake

Under the hood, a 3.5L V6 engine pairs with an 8-speed automatic transmission to provide dependable performance with an EPA rating of 22 city and 33 highway mpg. Front-wheel drive enhances traction and maximizes interior space for passengers and cargo. The silver exterior finish maintains its appeal and resists showing minor imperfections.

The cabin features NuLuxe seat trim with 10-way power adjustable front seats that offer support for extended drives. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to seasonal conditions, while the driver seat memory function stores your preferred position for easy recall. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light and enhances the sense of openness.

Safety systems are comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain vehicle stability. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.

Convenience features reflect Lexus attention to detail. The rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, while the windshield de-icer clears frost quickly on cold mornings. HomeLink garage door transmitter integration allows hands-free access to your garage. Remote keyless entry, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and a trip computer simplify daily operation.

The Accessory Package includes carpet trunk mat, key gloves, alloy wheel locks, and cargo net to protect your vehicle and belongings. Wood trim accents throughout the cabin add warmth and visual interest to the cockpit.

- Bengal Red and Black perforated Nappa leather upholstery
- 19" AMG® Twin 5-Spoke wheels with black accents
- COMAND® Navigation system with touchpad controller
- Premium audio system with 13 speakers and SiriusXM Radio

- Power heated front bucket seats with memory function
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone climate
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and Homelink garage door transmitter

The exterior showcases the distinctive designo Selenite Grey Magno paint, complemented by the purposeful AMG® styling that defines this model. The athletic stance is enhanced by the 19" AMG® Twin 5-Spoke wheels finished in black, creating a commanding presence on any road.

Step inside to discover the Bengal Red and Black perforated Nappa leather upholstery that wraps the power heated front bucket seats. The interior combines genuine wood accents on the dashboard and door panels with a sport steering wheel, creating an environment that balances luxury with performance-oriented design. Automatic temperature control with front dual zone capability ensures comfort for all occupants, while the overhead console and compass add practical convenience.

The COMAND® Navigation system with touchpad controller serves as the hub of your connectivity, working seamlessly with Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto® for full smartphone integration. The premium audio system features 13 speakers and SiriusXM Radio, delivering quality sound for every journey. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep essential functions within easy reach.

The all-wheel drive 4MATIC® system pairs with an adaptive suspension to deliver responsive handling characteristics. Speed-sensing steering, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide confidence in various driving conditions. The comprehensive safety package includes dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag protection, along with an eCall Emergency System.

With 40,046 miles on the odometer, this CLS has been carefully maintained and is ready to serve its next owner with the same commitment to quality and performance. The rear parking camera adds practical safety for everyday driving, while the power moonroof and split folding rear seats enhance versatility.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this 2019 Mercedes-Benz CLS CLS 53 AMG® 4MATIC® firsthand and discover how it meets your automotive needs.

description: SLEEK, SOPHISTICATED, AMG-STYLED, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, LUXURY IN MOTION! The 2019 Mercedes-Benz CLS 450 4MATIC brings genuine four-door coupe drama to the luxury sedan segment, and this AMG Line example pairs that striking silhouette with a comprehensive list of factory upgrades. Built on the same architecture as the E-Class but wrapped in a sportier, more sculpted body, this CLS delivers what reviewers have called restrained luxury, technological and material excellence without ever tipping into ostentatiousness. Under the hood, a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six paired with Mercedes' EQ Boost mild-hybrid system and standard 4MATIC all-wheel drive gives this CLS genuine composure and confidence, whether cruising the highway or carving a mountain road in the rain. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The CLS pioneered the four-door coupe segment, and this third generation refined that formula into something genuinely special: a car that drives with real athleticism while still delivering the comfort and technology buyers expect from a Mercedes-Benz flagship. Buyers consistently choose the CLS over more conventional luxury sedans because it doesn't ask them to sacrifice style for substance. Reviewers have specifically praised how the redesigned CLS feels smaller and lighter on its feet than its predecessor, flicking between corners with genuine composure rather than the classic heavyweight cruiser character of earlier generations. That blend of sharp handling and everyday livability has made the CLS a compelling alternative to the Audi A7 and BMW 6 Series. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have consistently praised the CLS 450 4MATIC for its responsive, composed driving character, noting that its all-wheel-drive system delivers awesome traction and stable handling even in wet conditions. Its turbocharged inline-six has been specifically highlighted for delivering power in a smooth, linear fashion that never feels weak, while the cabin's build quality and design have been compared favorably to an auto show concept car. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 30,659-mile mark. While this CLS's factory New Vehicle Limited Warranty has expired by time, Mercedes-Benz's turbocharged inline-six and EQ Boost mild-hybrid system have a strong reputation for durability, and with continued specialized maintenance, this CLS should have plenty of dependable miles left ahead. STANDARD FEATURES Every CLS 450 4MATIC comes standard with 19-inch wheels, LED headlights, a sunroof, and keyless ignition, along with a comprehensive active safety suite that includes blind-spot assist, a rearview camera, and active brake assist. That standard equipment list gives every CLS buyer a genuinely well-rounded starting point before a single option is added. INSTALLED OPTIONS This CLS was extensively optioned at the factory, headlined by the AMG Line package and a comprehensive list of comfort, audio, and styling upgrades. Premium Package Inductive Wireless Charging with NFC Pairing Lets the driver charge a compatible phone simply by setting it down, no cables required. SiriusXM Radio Expands entertainment options well beyond standard AM/FM. Subscription may be required. Exterior Lighting Package Full-LED Headlamps Provide sharper, more precise illumination than standard halogen lighting. Intelligent Highbeam Assist Automatically toggles between high and low beams based on oncoming traffic, keeping the road ahead well lit without blinding other drivers. AMG Line Mercedes-Benz Star in Radiator Grille Gives the front fascia a more prominent, sport-oriented presence. Brushed Aluminum Sport Pedals with Rubber Studs Add a genuine motorsport-inspired detail underfoot. Black Headliner Reinforces the cabin's sportier, more focused visual theme. Multi-Function Sports Steering Wheel with Flat Bottom Improves knee clearance and reinforces the car's sportier driving character. 19-Inch AMG Twin 5-Spoke Wheels Give this CLS a more aggressive stance than the standard wheel design. Standalone Features Burmester Surround Sound System Delivers concert-quality audio that matches the drama of everything else in this cabin. Active Multicontour Front Seats with Massage Feature Adjust dynamically to support the driver and passenger through corners while offering genuine massage functionality for long drives. Front Seats Rapid Heating Functionality Warms the front seats noticeably faster than a standard heated seat system on cold mornings. Rear Deck Spoiler Adds a subtle, sporty finishing touch to the CLS's already dramatic rear-end styling. CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN The CLS 450 4MATIC pairs its turbocharged inline-six with Mercedes' EQ Boost mild-hybrid system, an integrated 48-volt starter-generator that adds up to 21 horsepower and 184 lb-ft of torque in short bursts during acceleration. That extra shove smooths out everyday driving while also enabling a fuel-saving sailing mode that briefly shuts off the engine under certain conditions. NO PLUGGING NECESSARY! The mild-hybrid battery automatically charges itself during normal driving and regenerative braking, allowing you to enjoy improved efficiency and smoother acceleration without changing your daily routine. MECHANICAL FEATURES Power comes from Mercedes' turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six, producing a combined 362 horsepower and 369 lb-ft of torque with the EQ Boost system's assistance, paired with a smooth-shifting 9-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes quotes a 0-to-60-mph time of 4.8 seconds with 4MATIC all-wheel drive, quick enough to comfortably outrun plenty of dedicated sports cars. 4MATIC all-wheel drive continuously manages power delivery for confident traction in any weather, and reviewers have specifically praised the system's ability to maintain stable, composed handling even in wet conditions, all without sacrificing the CLS's genuinely engaging driving character. EXTERIOR FEATURES The CLS's coupe-like roofline and sculpted bodywork give it a dramatically different presence than a traditional three-box luxury sedan. The AMG Line package's 19-inch twin 5-spoke wheels and Mercedes-Benz star grille badge reinforce that sportier visual theme, while the rear deck spoiler adds a final touch of purposeful styling. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the CLS's cabin has been praised for delivering genuine wow factor, with build quality and design that reviewers have compared to an auto show concept car. The AMG Line's black headliner and flat-bottom sport steering wheel, combined with the Active Multicontour massage seats, create a cabin that's as dramatic to sit in as the exterior is to look at. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY A 12.3-inch high-resolution central display anchors the technology experience, controlled via Mercedes' COMAND system with touchpad controller and intuitive steering-wheel touch controls. The Burmester Surround Sound System elevates every drive well beyond what a standard luxury audio setup delivers. Inductive wireless charging with NFC pairing keeps compatible phones powered without a single cable, while SiriusXM adds expanded entertainment options, subscription may be required. SAFETY FEATURES This CLS comes standard with blind-spot assist, a rearview camera, and active brake assist, which not only warns of a potential collision but can automatically begin braking to help avoid it. The panorama roof floods the cabin with natural light, while the MB Navigation system provides turn-by-turn guidance with seamless integration.

Safety and convenience define the driving experience. Active Distance Assist Distronic provides intelligent cruise control, while the Surround View camera system and GUARD 360 technology protect you and your passengers. Ventilated front seats offer climate control comfort, and the comprehensive airbag array includes front, side, and knee protection strategies.

This C 300 retains the remainder of its factory warranty, providing peace of mind with every mile. The original MSRP was $56,345, and this well-appointed sedan is ready for its next chapter with a discerning driver who appreciates quality and craftsmanship.

Technology seamlessly enhances your daily drive. The sophisticated black exterior paired with the 17" Pewter Gray alloy wheels presents a polished appearance that turns heads while the heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators add both style and practicality to your daily drives.

The exterior parking camera and rear-view display help you navigate with confidence, while the illuminated Audi Beam-Rings welcome you each time you approach the vehicle. The all-weather mats protect your interior investment from the elements.
